blocks.text: You can add business units and assign them to a single group or multiple groups. Users in the group can view data and perform tasks on cloud accounts within the assigned business units.

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Business Unit Management.
On the Business Unit Management page, click Add Business Unit.
In the Add Business Unit window:
Name: Enter a name for the business unit.
Assign To Groups: Select the required groups from the drop-down menu.

blocks.text: By default, the "Default Super Admin" and "Default Read Only" predefined groups are assigned to all business units.
The business unit is added and displayed on the Business Unit Management page.
